A-03 Program settings

Bangla name: প্রোগ্রাম সেটিংস

← 10 · Admin portal · Contents · Open queries

1. Name and purpose

Program settings. The commercial rules of a program: how many orders and seats a customer may buy, when selling opens and closes relative to an event, when ticket generation opens, the ticket-number prefix, VAT, service charge and the payment gateway. They are the defaults of every event of the program; an event can override them (A-08).

2. Trigger and actor

Staff with role admin or event_manager (the controller allows only these two). Entry: Prog. Managem. → a program → tab Program Settings (/program-management/program-home/:id).

3. Business flow

The admin selects a program, changes the values and presses Update. Rules of the form: maximum orders per customer per event; maximum seats per order; "ticket selling start from" (hours before the event starts); "ticket selling stop from" (hours before the event ends); "ticket available from" (hours before the event starts, when tickets can be generated, S-07); limited-availability threshold; ticket-number prefix; payment gateway (DgePay or SSLCommerz); VAT and service charge (amount or percentage); VAT inclusive.

4. Technical flow

  1. [HTTP + user token] The tab loads GET /admin/api/v1/program-settings/{programId} and fills the form; the program dropdown comes from GET /admin/api/v1/program.
  2. [HTTP + user token] Update sends PUT /admin/api/v1/program-settings with the whole ProgramSettings object (JSON body).
  3. ProgramSettingsManager.UpdateAsync loads the row by ProgramId ("No program settings found" if missing), copies the hours, limits, prefix, threshold, VAT-inclusive flag and gateway; then, if any event of the program is published, it refuses a change of VAT value/percentage flag or service-charge value/percentage flag with "Cannot update VAT and Service Charge while events are published."; otherwise it copies VAT and service charge too. It saves and deletes the Redis key program_settings_details:{programId} so the next read rebuilds it (X-25).
  4. Where the values are used: at event creation the program settings are copied into the event's own settings (A-07). When an event is read, EventManager computes TicketSellingStartDateTime = event start − TicketSellingStartFromHour, TicketSellingStopDateTime = event **end** − TicketSellingStopFromHour and TicketAvailabilityStartDateTime = event start − TicketAvailableFromHour, from the event's own settings if it has them, else from the program settings (A-08). Booking reads the limits and the charges at order time (P-06).

5. Components

Kind Component
Client features/program-management/components/program-settings/*, services/program-settings.service.ts (a second copy sits in the unlinked features/program-settings module)

6. API contracts

Method Path Auth Request Response Main errors
GET /admin/api/v1/program-settings Admin, EventManager none ProgramSettings[]
GET /admin/api/v1/program-settings/{programId} same path ProgramSettings
PUT /admin/api/v1/program-settings same ProgramSettings ProgramSettings 400 No program settings found, Cannot update VAT and Service Charge while events are published.

Primary sample, PUT body (property names from ProgramSettings; the values shown are the creation defaults of A-02):

{
  "id": 7,
  "programId": 12,
  "limitedAvailabilityThreshold": 60,
  "allowableMaximumOrderPerUser": 4,
  "allowableMaximumSeatPerOrder": 4,
  "ticketSellingStartFromHour": 72,
  "ticketSellingStopFromHour": 1,
  "ticketAvailableFromHour": 48,
  "ticketNumberPrefix": "T20",
  "vat": 15,
  "isVatPercentage": true,
  "serviceCharge": 0,
  "isServiceChargePercentage": true,
  "isVatInclusive": true,
  "paymentGateway": 1
}

paymentGateway: 1 = DgePay, 2 = SSLCommerz (the Admin service sends numbers, not names).

7. Data and side effects

ProgramSettings row updated; cache key deleted; activity log entry. Existing events are not changed (they hold their own copy of the settings).

9. Handover notes

  1. The settings are copied, not referenced. Every event created through the portal gets its own EventSettings row at creation, so changing the program settings affects only events created afterwards; use A-08 to change an existing event.
  2. VAT lock only looks at published events of the program; a draft event keeps the old values until it is saved again, and the rule does not protect orders that were already placed.
  3. The ticket-selling stop is measured from the event end (EndDateTime), unlike the start, which is measured from the event start; an event without an end date would fail in EventManager (entity.EndDateTime.Value).
  4. TicketNumberPrefix can be edited any time; new tickets use the prefix of the event's settings (S-07), so one event may have tickets with two prefixes if it changes in between.
  5. The payment gateway is an enum number in JSON; SSLCommerz is supported by the form but its callbacks are inactive (Appendix A); choose DgePay unless BS23 confirms otherwise [UNCONFIRMED: Q-19].
